svg.desc: TurtleBlock AI — building, exploring, and thinking together, with a block-shelled turtle, books by Papert, Dewey, Bruner and Logo, Critical Techno Constructivism, ChatGPT and me, Could Minecraft be a school?, and Whoooo Knooowwwssssss on the distant rock face.
